cross_verification.note_en: Malawi's Department of Immigration (immigration.gov.mw) was fetched directly across seven pages during this research pass: /passports/passport-process/, /passports/how-to-fill-your-application-form/, /passports/types-of-passport/, /check-list/, /passports/apply-for-passport/, /services/download-applications/, and the main /passports/ page. All confirm that 'two passport size photographs' are required for most passport applications, but none publish a photo specification (dimensions, background color, head height, expression, glasses/headwear policy, etc.) — the department directs applicants to the actual application checklist / in-person process instead. The department's newer online portal, epassport.gov.mw, where a detailed spec might be published, could not be reached (connection refused) during this pass. Third-party photo-service sites publish specific numbers (commonly 35x45mm, white background, 6 months) but none are Malawian government sources, so per the truthfulness gate none were carried into verified.
